visuals.heading: MBBS and Doctor Salary: Government Versus Private

figures.label: Allowance Amount Reported
figures.source: Basic pay under the 7th CPC pay matrix runs Level 10, roughly Rs 56,100-1,77,500, plus a Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) of about 20% of basic that is unique to doctors.

figures.label: Monthly Pay Allowance
figures.source: Junior Residents at central institutes like AIIMS are commonly cited around Rs 52,000-53,000 cash per month, Senior Residents around Rs 68,000-70,000, before other allowances.

blocks.heading: Nursing Salary: Private, Government, and Abroad

items.text: Government and central institutions like AIIMS or ESIC often start meaningfully higher once allowances stack onto the 7th CPC Staff Nurse scale (Level VII, roughly Rs 44,900-1,42,400 basic).
Research associate, quality, or sales-adjacent roles are the common first job, in the roughly Rs 21,000-41,000/month range.
A UGC/CSIR-type research fellowship during a PhD commonly pays roughly Rs 31,000-37,000/month, plan around that runway, not the eventual post-PhD number, while you are still studying.

figures.label: Relevant Experience Window
figures.source: With 3-5 years of experience and a CPC or CCS credential, pay commonly moves to Rs 6-13.8 LPA, and senior auditors or specialty coders can reach Rs 12-20 LPA.
